title: Unit
description: The unit record in .pairingbuddy/run/unit.json: a branch and the task records that accumulate on it.

type.description: The branch type pb unit open was given (feat, fix, chore, refactor, spike): the guess of the task type before intake, which pb run open checks the runners against. May be absent (units opened before it).

configAcceptances.description: The test-config changes the human accepted with pb human accept while the unit was open, oldest first; configHash is the last newHash. May be absent (none accepted).

lenses.description: The task ledger's lens records when the task ended (the safety-net record: stage, attempt, lenses, counts, uncovered names); absent when none was written.

fullSuite.description: The task ledger's full-suite result when the task ended; null when none was run.
